svg.title: Qualified authority and content assurance remain distinct
svg.desc: An illustrative policy under A2. (a) An authority edge validated at E bounds the decision by K(E) if it is a single direct attack target satisfying T3(c). (b) If graph-profile issuance and validation make those edges Q, an E declaration that can independently change the accepted outcome still bounds the decision. Equality requires a matching lower bound from T3(a).

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Qualified authority and content assurance remain distinct

An illustrative policy under A2. (a) An authority edge validated at E bounds the decision by K(E) if it is a single direct attack target satisfying T3(c). (b) If graph-profile issuance and validation make those edges Q, an E declaration that can independently change the accepted outcome still bounds the decision. Equality requires a matching lower bound from T3(a).
